summary: Two Bedroom Home · Large Living Space · Available Now · Rear Gated Driveway
description:
My Property Box welcome this stunning two bedroom family home to the Lettings market. Available now, the terraced home offers large living space with decorative yet practical hardwood flooring, galley kitchen with fitted appliances. Through the kitchen there is access to a private rear garden with gated driveway. Family bathroom to the rear which features shower over bath. To the first floor are two well sized double bedrooms. There is also loft space.

Located in the heart of popular Ashington, the property is the ideal base for those who desire easy access to the A19, A1 and Northumberland. A short commuting distance to local shops, recreational areas and hospitals. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
